script:
-- ikortyi Executor - Rainbow GUI
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local Player = Players.LocalPlayer
local PlayerGui = Player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

-- Создаем основной GUI
local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
ScreenGui.Name = "IkortyiRainbowExecutor"
ScreenGui.Parent = PlayerGui
ScreenGui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false

-- Основной фрейм
local MainFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
MainFrame.Name = "MainFrame"
MainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 500, 0, 400)
MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -250, 0.5, -200)
MainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20)
MainFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
MainFrame.Active = true
MainFrame.Draggable = true
MainFrame.Parent = ScreenGui

-- Радужный бордер
local RainbowBorder = Instance.new("Frame")
RainbowBorder.Name = "RainbowBorder"
RainbowBorder.Size = UDim2.new(1, 6, 1, 6)
RainbowBorder.Position = UDim2.new(0, -3, 0, -3)
RainbowBorder.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
RainbowBorder.BorderSizePixel = 0
RainbowBorder.ZIndex = 0
RainbowBorder.Parent = MainFrame

-- Внутренний фрейм
local InnerFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
InnerFrame.Name = "InnerFrame"
InnerFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
InnerFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
InnerFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 15)
InnerFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
InnerFrame.Parent = MainFrame

-- Заголовок с радужным эффектом
local Title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
Title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40)
Title.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
Title.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(10, 10, 10)
Title.Text = "ikortyi EXECUTOR"
Title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
Title.TextSize = 20
Title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
Title.Parent = InnerFrame

-- Кнопка закрытия
local CloseButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
CloseButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 30, 0, 30)
CloseButton.Position = UDim2.new(1, -35, 0, 5)
CloseButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 50)
CloseButton.Text = "X"
CloseButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
CloseButton.TextSize = 16
CloseButton.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
CloseButton.Parent = InnerFrame

-- Поле для ввода скрипта
local ScriptBox = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
ScriptBox.Size = UDim2.new(0.95, 0, 0, 200)
ScriptBox.Position = UDim2.new(0.025, 0, 0.15, 0)
ScriptBox.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 25)
ScriptBox.BorderSizePixel = 0
ScriptBox.ScrollBarThickness = 8
ScriptBox.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 10, 0)
ScriptBox.Parent = InnerFrame

local ScriptInput = Instance.new("TextBox")
ScriptInput.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 1, -10)
ScriptInput.Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, 5)
ScriptInput.BackgroundTransparency = 1
ScriptInput.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
ScriptInput.TextSize = 14
ScriptInput.Font = Enum.Font.Code
ScriptInput.Text = "-- Введите ваш скрипт здесь\nprint('Добро пожаловать в ikortyi executor!')"
ScriptInput.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
ScriptInput.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
ScriptInput.ClearTextOnFocus = false
ScriptInput.MultiLine = true
ScriptInput.TextWrapped = true
ScriptInput.Parent = ScriptBox

-- Кнопка executor
local ExecuteButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
ExecuteButton.Size = UDim2.new(0.45, 0, 0, 40)
ExecuteButton.Position = UDim2.new(0.025, 0, 0.75, 0)
ExecuteButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 150, 0)
ExecuteButton.Text = "EXECUTOR"
ExecuteButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
ExecuteButton.TextSize = 16
ExecuteButton.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
ExecuteButton.Parent = InnerFrame

-- Кнопка очистки
local ClearButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
ClearButton.Size = UDim2.new(0.45, 0, 0, 40)
ClearButton.Position = UDim2.new(0.525, 0, 0.75, 0)
ClearButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 0, 0)
ClearButton.Text = "ОЧИСТИТЬ"
ClearButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
ClearButton.TextSize = 16
ClearButton.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
ClearButton.Parent = InnerFrame

-- Поле вывода
local OutputFrame = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
OutputFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0.95, 0, 0, 80)
OutputFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.025, 0, 0.9, -85)
OutputFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20)
OutputFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
OutputFrame.ScrollBarThickness = 6
OutputFrame.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 5, 0)
OutputFrame.Parent = InnerFrame

local OutputLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
OutputLayout.Parent = OutputFrame

-- Функция для вывода сообщений
local function logOutput(message, color)
    color = color or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    
    local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 20)
    label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    label.Text = "> " .. message
    label.TextColor3 = color
    label.TextSize = 12
    label.Font = Enum.Font.Code
    label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    label.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
    label.Parent = OutputFrame
    
    -- Автопрокрутка вниз
    OutputFrame.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, OutputFrame.AbsoluteCanvasSize.Y)
end

-- Анимация радужных цветов
local rainbowColors = {
    Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0),     -- Красный
    Color3.fromRGB(255, 127, 0),   -- Оранжевый
    Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 0),   -- Желтый
    Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0),     -- Зеленый
    Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 255),     -- Синий
    Color3.fromRGB(75, 0, 130),    -- Индиго
    Color3.fromRGB(148, 0, 211)    -- Фиолетовый
}

local currentColorIndex = 1

-- Функция для анимации радуги
local function startRainbowAnimation()
    while true do
        for i = 1, #rainbowColors do
            currentColorIndex = i
            
            -- Анимация для бордера
            local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear)
            local tween = TweenService:Create(
                RainbowBorder,
                tweenInfo,
                {BackgroundColor3 = rainbowColors[i]}
            )
            tween:Play()
            
            -- Анимация для заголовка
            local titleTween = TweenService:Create(
                Title,
                tweenInfo,
                {TextColor3 = rainbowColors[i]}
            )
            titleTween:Play()
            
            wait(0.5)
        end
    end
end

-- Обработчики событий
ExecuteButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    local scriptCode = ScriptInput.Text
    
    if scriptCode and scriptCode ~= "" then
        logOutput("Запуск скрипта...", Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 255))
        
        local success, result = pcall(function()
            local func = loadstring(scriptCode)
            if func then
                -- Создаем безопасное окружение
                local env = getfenv(func)
                local originalPrint = print
                
                env.print = function(...)
                    local args = {...}
                    local output = table.concat(args, " ")
                    logOutput(tostring(output), Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255))
                    originalPrint(...)
                end
                
                env.warn = function(...)
                    local args = {...}
                    local output = table.concat(args, " ")
                    logOutput("[WARN] " .. tostring(output), Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 0))
                    warn(...)
                end
                
                setfenv(func, env)
                return func()
            else
                error("Ошибка загрузки скрипта")
            end
        end)
        
        if success then
            logOutput("Скрипт выполнен успешно!", Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0))
            if result then
                logOutput("Результат: " .. tostring(result), Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 255))
            end
        else
            logOutput("Ошибка: " .. tostring(result), Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0))
        end
    else
        logOutput("Введите скрипт для выполнения", Color3.fromRGB(255, 165, 0))
    end
end)

ClearButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    ScriptInput.Text = ""
    logOutput("Поле очищено", Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 0))
end)

CloseButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    ScreenGui:Destroy()
end)

-- Горячая клавиша для скрытия/показа (F9)
local isVisible = true
UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.F9 then
        isVisible = not isVisible
        MainFrame.Visible = isVisible
    end
end)

-- Запускаем анимацию
coroutine.wrap(startRainbowAnimation)()

-- Начальное сообщение
logOutput("ikortyi Executor загружен! F9 - скрыть/показать", Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 255))
logOutput("Введите скрипт и нажмите EXECUTOR", Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255))

print("ikortyi Rainbow Executor успешно загружен!")
print("Нажмите F9 чтобы скрыть/показать интерфейс")
